card.title: Be There for Me
card.instruction: Get someone to show up, help, or stay involved as proof that the connection still matters.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Dad, will you come to my opening? Even for ten minutes?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't know anything about sculpture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You survived every school play. I still want you in my corner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your mother will be there. We haven't spoken since the divorce.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come before we open. I'll unpack the biggest piece with you. I want a memory of tonight with you in it too.

mechanism: A seeks Dad's presence at an opening and changes the form of participation to preserve proof of their connection.
confusable: Unlike demanding attendance for numbers, A must show why this person's involvement matters relationally.
comparison: D73-b avoids a divorced-parent encounter through early unpacking; D73-a avoids erasing memories through taping and shared sitting.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
